status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned
marketInitialScore: log of normalized JRA win market probability supplied as LightGBM init_score
latentWorth: for each OOS race, add the learned residual raw score to log JRA win market probability and softmax across runners

pairConversion.quinella: exact Plackett-Luce probability that A,B occupy first and second in either order
pairConversion.wide: exact Plackett-Luce probability that A,B both appear in the first three positions, summing all ordered top-three paths

officialPairPreservation: compute the same Plackett-Luce pair proxies from JRA win-market worths; multiply actual JRA official quinella/wide pair-market probability by modelProxy/marketProxy, clip ratio to [0.25,4.0], and renormalize to original pair-market mass
ticketScore: corrected pair probability multiplied by JRA official odds; wide uses official lower bound
evaluation: horse top-order quality plus actual JRA top1/top3/top5/top9 pair returns in each OOS block
